description: Removal of condition 12 (Restricted use of commercial unit) of planning permission dated 07/04/2003 ref. 2002/3002 (Erection of four-storey building to provide 32 flats, 750 sq.m. commercial floorspace and basement car park.).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development has begun with 5 years from the date of the permission referenced 2022/0197 and dated 07 April 2003.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with site treatment to parking areas, access ways, surface treatment, and boundary treatment approved under details application refs: 2003/2349 & 2003/2412.
Reason: To ensure a high quality of development in compliance with Council Policy LP1.

Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with materials approved under details application ref 2003/1527. 
Reason: In order to assess the suitability of the proposed materials, in the interests of the appearance of the locality, in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP2.

Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with refuse details approved under details application ref: 2003/3286. 
Reason: In the interest of the appearance of the development and to safeguard visual amenity, in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with landscaping details approved under details application ref: 2003/2187
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance, in accordance with Council policies LP55 and LP56.

Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed FNH 270/P/01; FNH 270/P/02d; FNH 270/P/03d; FNH 270/P/04d; FNH 270/P/05d; FNH 270/P/06b; FNH 270/P/07b; FNH 270/P/08c; FNH 270/P/09c; FNH 270/P/10c; FNH 270/P/11A; FNH 270/P/12b; Marketing Report (dated 17/03/2026); A letter (dated 27/05/2026), 608/02/M; 03/N; 04/P; 09/B.
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 7 - The parking areas shown on the approved plans shall be retained for parking purposes for the users of the development and for no other purpose.
Reason: To ensure adequate arrangements are made for off-street parking.

Condition : 8 - The uses that may occupy the commercial areas identified on the approved plans, shall  not operate or be open to customers other than between the hours of 0800 and 2200 hours Monday to Friday, and 0900-1800 hours on Saturday and Sunday, and at no other times.
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policy LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the provisions of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, or any future enactment of that Order, no windows, doors or glazed areas (other than such as may be shown on the approved plans) shall be formed in the north and south facing walls of the building without the prior written consent of the local planning authority.
Reason: To protect the privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking, in accordance with Council policy LP2.

Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding the provisions of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 or any future re-enactment of that Order, no satellite dishes, telecommunications masts or equipment or associated structures, shall be installed on the building without the prior written approval of the local planning authority.
Reason: To protect the appearance of the building and accord with Council policies LP2 and LP22.

Condition : 11 - The uses hereby permitted shall not include use in connection with the hiring, distribution of or trading in motor vehicles, or in connection with driving Instruction.
Reason: Inadequate parking and service facilities are provided for such uses.

Condition : 12 - The use of the commercial floorspace shown on the approved drawings shall not be used for Class E(f) Creche, day nursery or day centre.
Reason: To ensure that the council retains control over the use, in order that it can assess their suitability in terms of development plan policies and other material considerations.

Condition : 13 - No amplified sound/music or speech, large congregations of customers, or intensive servicing shall be generated by the use hereby approved so as to be audible at the nearest residential premises. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policy LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 14 - Prior to the commencement of use, submission and approval of a detailed acoustic assessment, including BS4142 methodology, demonstrating that noise from the development will not exceed background levels at the nearest noise-sensitive receptors. The development shall be occupied and operated in accordance with the approved details. 
Reason:  In the interests of amenity in accordance with Council policy LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 15 - Prior to the commencement of any gym use, details  of an acoustic assessment undertaken in accordance with with ProPG: Gym Acoustics Guidance (2023), BS 4142:2014+A1:2019, BS 8233:2014, and any other relevant guidance current at the time of submission, demonstrating that noise from the development will not exceed background levels at the nearest noise-sensitive receptors.
Reason: In the interests of amenity in accordance with Council policy LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 16 - Prior to occupation of commercial use part of the development, development details of a delivery and servicing plan including hours of operation shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The development shall be occupied and operated in accordance with the approved delivery and servicing plan. 
Reason: To ensure that adequate arrangements are made for deliveries and servicing to the site and to ensure that the plan is sensitive to the amenity of local residents in accordance with Council policies LP2, LP14, and LP50 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024.

Condition : 17 - Noise limits and mitigation measures for all fixed plant and equipment shall be submitted to and approved in writing to the local planning authority. The proposed development should implement the approved details and they should remain in place permanently.
Reason: To ensure the safety and security of residents in accordance with Council policies LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan .

Condition : 18 - The development shall not include external seating or customer areas without prior approval by the local planning authority. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policies LP2 and LP14 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024.

Condition : 19 - Prior to first commencement of its use, a scheme for the extraction and treatment of fumes and odours generated from cooking undertaken within any commercial kitchen shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any equipment, plant or process approved pursuant to such details shall be installed prior to the first use of the premises and shall be operated and retained in accordance with the approved details and operated in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.
Reason: To protect the occupiers of the building and neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policies LP2 and LP27 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 20 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
